description: Lint financial, legal and consent copy (fees, rates, terms, privacy notices, error and decline messages) for plain language. Give text and optionally kind (fee, rate, terms, consent, privacy, error, marketing). Returns Flesch Reading Ease and Flesch-Kincaid grade (target grade 8 or lower), average sentence length, long words, passive voice, stacked negatives, legalese and jargon with plain replacements, vague money wording ('up to', 'as low as', 'may apply', 'certain fees') with why regulators dislike it, key terms buried after the first 150 characters or in long sentences, a per-kind checklist of missing elements, and draft rewrites for the worst sentences. A writing check, not legal or compliance advice.

kind.description: What the copy is, which picks the checklist: fee, rate, terms, consent, privacy, error or marketing. Guessed from the text if omitted.

text.description: The copy to check, as paragraphs or one sentence per line
